{{Quote|Heard some strangers have been snooping around Port Granost. Think the Republic will do anything about that?''"<br />"''Don't see why they would. They haven't used that supply depot in years.|Two Kessan's Landing residents|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Port Granost''' was a small city located on [[Kessan's Landing]], an island on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. It was once used as a supply depot by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" />
